headline: Anthropic's biolab made a discovery it's comparing to Crispr
summary: Anthropic's AI, Claude, "autonomously discovered" a new enzyme system. This system is compared to the powerful gene-editing tool Crispr. It's the first major result from Anthropic's new wet lab, showcasing AI's scientific potential.

headline: Bernie Sanders proposes banning 'superintelligence' and putting violators in prison
summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders and Rep. Greg Casar introduce a bill to ban artificial superintelligence. The bill defines superintelligence as capable of humanity's "destruction or disempowerment." Violators of the proposed "Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act" could face up to 20 years in prison.

headline: Logitech's new Blue Yeti 2 mic adjusts itself to where you are
summary: Logitech G launches the Blue Yeti 2, a successor to the popular USB microphone. New features include an interactive LED display and AI de-noising. The mic also boasts a proximity-based voice sensor for automatic adjustments.

headline: Logitech's new haptics-based gaming mouse is a little better and $20 more
summary: Logitech introduces the G Pro Superstrike, a new haptics-based gaming mouse. It uses haptic actuators instead of mechanical switches for custom click feel and lower latency. The upgraded mouse comes with a $20 price increase over previous models.

headline: Grand Theft Auto 6 Shirts Given Away for Free at Tokyo Game Show Are Being Resold Online for Hundreds of Dollars
summary: Exclusive Grand Theft Auto 6 shirts were distributed for free at Tokyo Game Show 2026. These limited-edition shirts are now being resold online. Resale prices are reportedly reaching hundreds of dollars per shirt.

headline: The 4K-Ready MSI Codex Z2 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC Drops to $1,699 After a $600 Discount
summary: The MSI Codex Z2 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC is now on sale for $1,699. This represents a significant $600 discount on the 4K-ready system. The powerful RTX 5070 Ti GPU alone often sells for over $1,000.

headline: The Walmart GeForce Week Sale Has Black Friday Worthy Gaming Laptop Deals
summary: Walmart's GeForce Week Sale features major discounts on gaming laptops. Deals are described as "Black Friday worthy" for RTX 5060 to 5080 models. These are reportedly the best prices seen all year on these specific laptops.

headline: The Walmart GeForce Week Sale Has Black Friday Worthy Gaming PC Deals, But They're Selling Out
summary: Walmart's GeForce Week Sale offers "Black Friday worthy" deals on prebuilt gaming PCs. Discounts cover systems equipped with RTX 5060 to 5090 GPUs. These popular deals are selling out quickly due to high demand and competitive pricing.

headline: UK military jamming other nations' satellites to defend itself, BBC told
summary: The UK military is reportedly jamming other nations' satellites for self-defense. The head of the RAF states the UK faces "unprecedented threats" in space. A new unit has been established to specifically defend Britain's satellites.

headline: Home secretary says undetected migrant landings 'unacceptable'
summary: The Home Secretary labels recent undetected migrant landings as "unacceptable." Two unescorted migrant boats arrived without interception. These mark the first uncontrolled landings recorded in the UK since 2025.

headline: Watch: Moment pilots eject as RAF jet crashes in Anglesey
summary: Footage captures the moment two pilots ejected from an RAF jet. The jet subsequently crashed in Anglesey. Both pilots sustained only minor injuries after ejecting.

headline: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
summary: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian delivered a defiant speech at the UN. He declared Iran would never "bend the knee" to external pressure. This comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran without a peace deal.
